what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Haiti in Mexico: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 50961 Haitian asylum seekers in Mexico, 21.6% of all asylum seekers from Haiti.
Refugees from Haiti, a separate group, live mostly in Brazil, France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Haiti in 2004, with FLRN and OP Lavalas, and again from 2024 to 2025 with Viv Ansanm.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 6 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 78905, at the end of 2024 and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mexico.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Mexico only.
